title: Picard Proximal Monte Carlo for Parallel Bayesian Imaging with Score-Based Generative Priors
abstract: arXiv:2608.17666v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Bayesian imaging inverse problems often require sampling from high-dimensional posterior distributions. While recent score-based and diffusion models provide expressive Bayesian priors, their sampling procedures remain inherently sequential and computationally expensive for large-scale imaging applications. We propose PiX-MC, a time-parallel posterior sampling framework based on proximal Langevin dynamics and Picard iteration. The proximal-likelihood formulation exploits the fact that many imaging likelihoods admit efficient, problem-specific proximal operators, while Picard refinement exposes parallelism across discretization nodes and naturally supports multi-GPU implementation. To further improve practical scalability and sampling performance, we develop multi-block and annealed variants of the proposed framework. translated_title: 基于分数生成先验的并行贝叶斯成像的Picard近端蒙特卡洛方法
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.17666v1 公告类型：新 摘要：贝叶斯成像逆问题通常需要从高维后验分布中进行采样。虽然最近的基于分数和扩散模型提供了富有表现力的贝叶斯先验，但其采样过程在大规模成像应用中本质上仍是顺序的且计算成本高昂。我们提出了PiX-MC，一种基于近端朗之万动力学和Picard迭代的时间并行后验采样框架。近端似然公式利用了这样一个事实：许多成像似然函数具有高效、问题特定的近端算子，而Picard细化则在离散化节点间暴露了并行性，并自然支持多GPU实现。为了进一步提高实际可扩展性和采样性能，我们开发了所提出框架的多块和退火变体。我们在透明假设下建立了收敛保证，适用于非对数凹后验分布和完美先验的情况。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于近端朗之万动力学和Picard迭代的时间并行后验采样框架PiX-MC，通过利用成像似然的近端算子和多GPU并行性，显著加速了大规模贝叶斯成像问题中的高维后验采样，并提供了收敛保证。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes PiX-MC, a time-parallel posterior sampling framework based on proximal Langevin dynamics and Picard iteration, which accelerates high-dimensional posterior sampling in large-scale Bayesian imaging by exploiting problem-specific proximal operators and multi-GPU parallelism, with convergence guarantees under transparent assumptions.
